meta.name: ModelGarage: the personal compute workshop
meta.description: A precise, quiet workshop where people choose which models belong on their own machine.
source_references: Original ModelGarage workshop direction with a graphite workbench, lime action and locally served fonts.
QVAC SDK 0.22.0 model catalog, combined memory assessment and explicit local load test.
Decorative green workers in hard hats carry model-labelled objects without changing controls or assessment results.

color.palette_type: analogous neutral graphite with a restrained lime accent

primary.role: Headings and primary text on graphite

secondary.role: Secondary explanations, labels, and quiet metadata

accent.role: Main check action, selected controls, and small brand mark

neutral.usage: Light bone is the foreground. Graphite is the page background, iron panels add depth, and clear neutral borders delineate interactive controls.

color.contrast_strategy: Light text on solid dark surfaces. Body text exceeds 4.5:1, large type exceeds 3:1, and every state carries a text label in addition to its color.

crew_palette.usage: Palette for decorative green characters, workwear, hard hats, goggles, and cargo. Existing product colors and form tokens are unchanged.

typography.font_style_notes: Condensed semibold display type gives the workshop its identity. Humanist geometric body type keeps controls approachable. Monospace appears only on real measurements and model evidence. All font files are served locally.

spacing.content_density: Comfortable primary decisions with compact evidence rows
spacing.section_rhythm: 32px from masthead to title, 32px to workbench, 24px within major panels, 8px between label and field

layout.grid_system: Two-column asymmetric workbench: 420px configurator and flexible assessment bay. The primary check action appears immediately after the language selector, within the first desktop viewport. A single column at 900px.
layout.alignment_tendency: Strict left aligned grid with a generously separated title and paired configurator/report

shape.border_usage: Solid 1px iron borders, slightly lighter on controls. A 2px lime focus ring and selected checkbox communicate action.
shape.divider_style: Quiet 1px horizontal rules between settings and evidence rows

elevation.depth_cues: Solid surface color, clear boundaries, and typographic scale

iconography.style: Simple geometric open garage mark and small directional arrows; static SVG only
iconography.preferred_set: Small original inline SVG shapes, no icon dependency

motion.entrance_pattern: Brief opacity reveal for returned evidence
motion.philosophy: Original functional UI motion stays unchanged. Decorative workers use long linear travel with held endpoints, brief turns, alternating feet, weighted cargo sway, and occasional blinks. Pause crew and reduced motion hold visible still poses. Hidden and offscreen routes pause.

components.button_style: Full width lime primary check action immediately after the language selector, acting on every setting in the form below it. Secondary actions use neutral outlines. Disabled controls retain readable labels and no hover movement.
components.input_style: Full width dark solid fields, visible labels, clear iron borders, and 44px minimum targets
components.card_style: A single configurator panel paired with an intentional report bay, not a repeated metric card grid
components.navigation_pattern: Compact masthead with product mark, local workspace status, and one back link to all apps
components.modal_style: No modal. Model download and memory allocation acknowledgment stays inline below a matching result.
components.list_style: Optional model rows with checkbox, capability label, actual file size, and secondary model name. Evidence uses separated rows and native details disclosures.
components.component_notes: Unknown evidence remains explicit. File size, memory budget, and computed floor are separately labelled. Backend and execution preferences live in advanced settings. Export, cancellation, refusal details, assumptions, engine report, and load acknowledgment remain available.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A clean personal workshop with a configuration bench and an empty inspection bay
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary industrial product typography and uncluttered equipment labels

visual_language.ornamentation: Small original garage mark and fine rules, with a decorative crew in measured open spaces. No characters cover inputs, results, or links.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Wide surrounding margins and generous report bay, tighter repeated settings
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Display heading establishes identity, the configuration panel guides choices, and a fit verdict becomes the report focal point
visual_language.focal_strategy: One dominant action before assessment; one clearly labelled verdict after assessment
visual_language.contrast_level: High for reading and controls, subdued for structure
visual_language.texture_usage: None; all surfaces are flat and solid

composition.hierarchy_method: Condensed type scale, spatial separation, and selective lime emphasis
composition.flow_direction: Choose on the left, inspect on the right, optionally load below the result
composition.grouping_strategy: Capability rows stay with model selection; advanced settings and supporting evidence are disclosed as groups
composition.negative_space_role: Keeps technical evidence calm and makes the first assessment feel intentional

imagery.illustration_style: Existing garage line art plus small original green worker characters in hard hats, carrying faceted, sealed model cargo in open spaces.
imagery.graphic_elements: An original open-bay SVG mark, rules, and unfilled stage labels
imagery.image_shape: Static SVG scaled within its viewBox without cropping

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Inline stage text, real transfer progress, clear verdict words, and visible stale-result warning
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Controls brighten their border or solid surface; no translation or fake depth
interaction_feel.loading_style: Actual stage text and transfer measurements, with the existing cancellation control when loading
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Low; focus, selected inputs, disclosure state, and result entry only

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct imperative: Check memory fit, Save result, Download and test load
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Shows the real selected model and explains that the fit report is waiting for a check; never invents hardware or a verdict
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: State what failed, keep the last evidence visible, and offer a concrete next action

overview.fallback_strategy: Characters remain visible in still poses for reduced motion, explicit pause, or missing Web Animations support. Routes outside the viewport and hidden documents pause. No worker intercepts input.
overview.primary_technology: SVG, CSS and Web Animations API

background_effects.description: Solid graphite background with no animated effect

text_effects.description: Live readable text without text effects

params.responsiveness: Static SVG and CSS layout only

svg_animations.description: Small green minion-like workers with hard hats, goggles, workwear, alternating feet, blinking eyes, and mysteriously shaped cargo tagged Qwen3, EmbeddingGemma, or Whisper. Route geometry follows actual open areas around the existing interface.

params.animation_method: Web Animations for travel and turns; CSS transforms for gait, cargo sway, hat follow-through and eye blinks. ResizeObserver updates geometry; IntersectionObserver pauses offscreen routes.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Crew is decorative and independent of model activity. It never implies a model is loading, selected, downloaded, or proven to fit. No canvas, raster assets, remote service, animation library, or continuous JavaScript frame loop is needed. Main app logic, native fit service, original styles, layout and data controls stay unchanged.
